# pocketid_api (Resource)

Manages a protected API resource and its permissions in Pocket-ID. API resources define OAuth 2.0 audiences and scopes. The `permission_ids` output maps each declared permission key to the Pocket-ID permission ID needed by `pocketid_api_client_access`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pocketid_api" "telemetry_ingest" {
  name     = "External telemetry ingest"
  resource = "https://ingest.nokiy.net"

  permissions = [
    {
      key         = "telemetry.write"
      name        = "Write telemetry"
      description = "Submit metrics, logs, and traces"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Import

Import an API resource using its Pocket-ID API resource ID:

```shell
terraform import pocketid_api.telemetry_ingest <api-id>
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the API resource.
- `permissions` (Set of Object) The complete set of permissions declared by this API.
- `resource` (String) The immutable OAuth 2.0 resource indicator (audience) for this API.

### Optional

- `permissions.description` (String) An optional permission description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Pocket-ID API resource ID.
- `permission_ids` (Map of String) A map from permission key to Pocket-ID permission ID.

### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `key` (String) The permission scope key, unique within this API.
- `name` (String) The human-readable permission name.
